''See also: [[Empire (The Elder Empire: Sea) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Aurelian Empire]] is a civilization currently facing significant instability and the threat of fragmentation. For several years, the realm has been managed by four [[Regents]] following the death of the Emperor, a loss that has led to growing political divisions and the risk of the unified state splitting into four separate kingdoms. [[The Empire]]'s stability is further threatened by the increasing activity of the [[Elders]] and their spawn, entities that possess immense power over life, death, time, space, and knowledge. These beings often work against humanity, seeking the downfall of civilization. The role of the Emperor is central to [[The Empire|the Empire]]'s survival. Historically, the Emperor maintained order by borrowing the power of the [[Elders]] to stand above humanity, acting as a figure capable of negotiating with these [[Great Elders]]. The position also involves unique abilities, such as the capacity to use a specialized throne to amplify [[Reading]], though this carries extreme mental risks. The Emperor is responsible for commanding [[The Empire|the Empire]]'s military forces, including the [[Blackwatch]] and the [[Luminian Order]], to contain Elder incursions and protect citizens. Various [[Imperial Guilds]], such as the Navigators, the [[Consultants]], the [[Champions]], and the [[Blackwatch]], serve different roles in maintaining [[The Empire|the Empire]]'s structure and defending against Elder threats.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|For five years, [[The Empire|the Empire]] has been maintained by a group of four [[Regents]]. During this period, the state officially registered every [[Soulbound]] located on the continent and saw travelers journey across its various territories. While [[The Empire|the Empire]] is governed by a ruler of Elderspawned descent, it maintains a profound hatred for the [[Elders]]. To protect its borders, the [[Blackwatch]] conducts studies on these [[Elders]]. Ultimately, [[The Empire|the Empire]] faces the existential threat of its civilization vanishing if it lacks proper direction.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[The Empire]] officially registered all [[Soulbound]] on the continent.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The characters have traveled throughout [[The Empire|the Empire]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c6">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Blackwatch]] studies [[Elders]] to defend [[The Empire|the Empire]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c8">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[The Empire]] holds a deep hatred for the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[The Empire]] is ruled by an Elderspawned ruler.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c15">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[The Empire]] functions as a governing body, though certain villages feel disconnected from its [[Authority|authority]]. Internal instability threatens the state as a lack of cooperation between various [[Guilds]] puts the entire structure at risk of collapse. While [[Calder]]'s crew demonstrates a willingness to defy [[The Empire|the Empire]], the loyal [[Guilds]] remain committed to protecting the people. Ultimately, [[Calder]] intends to steer this political entity through its challenges.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[The Empire]] is at risk of falling apart due to a lack of cooperation between [[Guilds]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[The Empire]] is a governing body that some villages feel they are not truly part of.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c9">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder]]'s crew was willing to defy [[The Empire|the Empire]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The loyal [[Guilds]] of [[The Empire|the Empire]] will protect the people.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[The Empire]] is a political entity that [[Calder]] intends to steer.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Identified by the moon-in-sun emblem, [[The Empire|the Empire]] is a political entity referenced during [[Cheska Bennett|Cheska]]'s accounts. The state stands to gain significantly from the restoration of the crown. Furthermore, it is noted that [[The Empire|the Empire]] would benefit from being governed by a ruler with a human lifespan. Despite various circumstances, [[The Empire|the Empire]]'s forces appeared to maintain control over their affairs.}}
